description: Trust between separate forests; SID filtering usually constrains what crosses.

telemetry.detail: Inter-forest Kerberos referrals; unusual cross-forest auth can be baselined.
Cross-forest access from a non-typical principal is more noteworthy than intra-forest, and SID filtering blocks many escalations.

prerequisite_privilege: None to traverse; escalation depends on SID-filter posture
abuse_primitive: Traverse the trust; abuse foreign-principal ACLs or (where SID filtering is relaxed) SIDHistory.
notes: Slightly higher than same-forest because cross-forest movement is rarer and more likely baselined.
